correctness.rationale: Reconstructed all 2n eigenvalues from the ordinary within-class, exchange-even and odd quotient blocks, and the convex objective max{|1-nx|,|T|,F(x,t)}. At n<=7, the odd block lower bound 1/sqrt(n) is attained at x=1/n,t=0 and other modes lie below it. At n>=8, explicit candidate x=2/[2(n-1)+sqrt(n²-8n+8)] has t=0, T=(n-2)/Z and odd eigenvalues ±T; the displayed convex subgradient cancellation gives a global lower bound for all invariant kernels, and symmetrization applies globally. Independent full-matrix eigenvalue comparisons at n=3,4,7,8,9,20,60 confirmed formulas; they are corroboration, not an infinite proof.
